title: Armour merchants
changes: Every village now has an armour merchant selling shields, body armour, helms and boots, with an armour stand and a shield rack by their spot.
Hilda on the Oakvale market square sells pieces from level 3 to 15, and Dorran in Saltmere from level 17 to 29.
Idris in the Kel Ashar market sells desert armour from level 32 to 48.
Armourers buy your old armour and mend worn gear, like the smiths.
